Coram : S. J. MUKHOPADHAYA*, S.A. BOBDE
A 8 PENAL CODE, 1860: ss.304-8, 498A - Dowry death - Presumption u/s.3048 - Essential ingredients, discussed - C In the instant case, victim-deceased died of burn injuries within 9 months of marriage - Dying declaration - In the first part of her dying declaration, she stated that it was the case alleged that her husband was harassing her for bringing dowry and doused her D in kerosene and set her on fire - Conviction of appellant­ husband by courts below - Challenged - Held: First part of the dying declaration was tutored by the husband as was apparent from the second part of dying
Decision Date : 02-07-2014 | Case No : CRIMINAL APPEAL No. 292/2011 | Disposal Nature : Dismissed | Bench : 2 Judges
